name: jaycheng1103/chatgpt-video-editing-skills
description: A short video editing skill collection. The sample skill, chatgpt-short-video-editor, covers transcription, editing strategy, rough cut, subtitles, preview, QA, and formal output, with a rule against silent tool installs and against formal output before preview approval. Tailored for Chinese language workflows.
install: npx skills add Jaycheng1103/chatgpt-video-editing-skills --full-depth (installer lets the user choose skills and detected agents), or git clone then local install
